# Spatial prediction of soil organic carbon in a semi-arid catchment

## Abstract

Soil organic carbon (SOC) and bulk density were measured at 120 sites (0-30 cm). Random forest predicted SOC with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 0.42% and R2 = 0.61 (Smith et al., 2019; Brown and Lee, 2020a). The results suggest that calcium carbonate content may control SOC storage.

## 1. Introduction

Digital soil mapping uses environmental covariates to predict soil properties [1, 3-5]. Yilmaz (2018) reported a mean available phosphorus of 7.5 mg kg-1. Cation exchange capacity (CEC) ranged from 12.3 to 38.9 cmol(+) kg-1.
